question: Based on our customer pizza order information, summarize the total quantity of each ingredient used in the pizzas we delivered. Output the name and quantity for each ingredient.
sql:
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT order_id 
    FROM pizza_clean_runner_orders 
    WHERE pickup_time IS NOT NULL
),
order_pizzas AS (
    SELECT co.order_id, co.pizza_id, co.exclusions, co.extras
    FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders co
    WHERE co.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM delivered_orders)
),
base_toppings AS (
    SELECT op.order_id, TRY_CAST(TRIM(s.value) AS INTEGER) AS topping_id
    FROM order_pizzas op
    JOIN pizza_recipes r ON op.pizza_id = r.pizza_id
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(string_split(r.toppings, ',')) AS s(value)
),
excluded_toppings AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT order_id, TRY_CAST(TRIM(value) AS INTEGER) AS excluded_topping_id
    FROM order_pizzas,
    UNNEST(string_split(exclusions, ',')) AS t(value)
    WHERE exclusions IS NOT NULL AND exclusions != ''
),
extra_toppings AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT order_id, TRY_CAST(TRIM(value) AS INTEGER) AS extra_topping_id
    FROM order_pizzas,
    UNNEST(string_split(extras, ',')) AS t(value)
    WHERE extras IS NOT NULL AND extras != ''
),
final_toppings AS (
    SELECT bt.order_id, bt.topping_id
    FROM base_toppings bt
    LEFT JOIN excluded_toppings et ON bt.order_id = et.order_id AND bt.topping_id = et.excluded_topping_id
    WHERE et.excluded_topping_id IS NULL
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT et2.order_id, et2.extra_topping_id AS topping_id
    FROM extra_toppings et2
)
SELECT tp.topping_name, COUNT(*) as quantity
FROM final_toppings ft
JOIN pizza_toppings tp ON ft.topping_id = tp.topping_id
GROUP BY tp.topping_name
ORDER BY tp.topping_name

{"sql": "-- Step 1: Build a CTE that gets all topping_ids (both base and extras) for each delivered pizza item,

WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT order_id 
    FROM pizza_clean_runner_orders 
    WHERE pickup_time IS NOT NULL
),
order_pizzas AS (
    SELECT co.order_id, co.pizza_id, co.exclusions, co.extras
    FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders co
    WHERE co.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM delivered_orders)
),
-- Get base toppings for each pizza

    SELECT op.order_id, op.pizza_id, op.exclusions, op.extras,
           TRY_CAST(TRIM(s.value) AS INTEGER) AS topping_id
    FROM order_pizzas op
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL UNNEST(string_split(r.toppings, ',')) AS s(value)
    JOIN pizza_recipes r ON op.pizza_id = r.pizza_id
),
-- Parse exclusions into individual topping_ids
excluded_toppings AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT order_id, TRY_CAST(TRIM(value) AS INTEGER) AS excluded_topping_id
    FROM order_pizzas,
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL UNNEST(string_split(exclusions, ',')) AS t(value)
    WHERE exclusions IS NOT NULL AND exclusions != ''
),
-- Parse extras into individual topping_ids  
extra_toppings AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT order_id, TRY_CAST(TRIM(value) AS INTEGER) AS extra_topping_id
    FROM order_pizzas,
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL UNNEST(string_split(extras, ',')) AS t(value)
    WHERE extras IS NOT NULL AND extras != ''
),
-- Combine base toppings minus exclusions, plus extras
all_toppings AS (
    SELECT bt.order_id, bt.topping_id
    FROM base_toppings bt
    LEFT JOIN excluded_toppings et ON bt.order_id = et.order_id AND bt.topping_id = et.excluded_topping_id
    WHERE et.excluded_topping_id IS NULL
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT et2.order_id, et2.extra_topping_id AS topping_id
    FROM extra_toppings et2
)
SELECT at.topping_id, COUNT(*) as quantity
FROM all_toppings at
GROUP BY at.topping_id
